title: Qualifying customer existence
brief: Find customers with qualifying activity without duplicate output.
instructions: Return customer identities with at least one paid order in the UTC 2024 interval. Each identity appears once.
For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes customer_id,customer_name from customers without solving qualifying customer existence.

hints.text: EXISTS asks about membership rather than joining every match.
Correlate qualifying orders to the outer customer identity.
Customer 1 has many qualifying orders; customer 10002 has none.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE customer_id = 1 AND status = 'paid'))::VARCHAR || '/' || (count(*) FILTER (WHERE customer_id = 10002 AND status = 'paid'))::VARCHAR FROM orders
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: customer 1 has many qualifying orders and customer 10002 has none
